text_block_list.text:
I bring Уиннинг Тикит to the infirmary
to get her
injury looked at...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Uuuugh... I'm... I'm done for...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The doctor said that even if I use my full
power,
this injury won't heal overnight...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! This is the worst! I just wanna
get back
to trainiiing...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list:
Let's not rush it. You need to take time to
recover.

text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! This is the worst! I just wanna
get back
to trainiiing...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list:
Let's not rush it. You need to take time to
recover.

text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Take my time to recover? But then I'll have less time to practice!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: Healing your injury is more important.

text_block_list.text:
Wow! I-is that... how much you care
about me?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: T-trainer... Thank you s-so much...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I can't believe this... You're supporting me so hard with your all-out kindness...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But even with all that power, this injury
won't go
away! Waaaahhhh!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Go beyond the limits of my full
power?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Yeah... That's it! If I can't recover with my regular all-out power...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I've just gotta find some kinda new,
super... ultra
all-out strength! And then
I'll be okay!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But how am I supposed to find it?
Hmmm...
Hrrrngh!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know! I need to get tons of
nutrition! I'll go
buy some food from the
academy store!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Forgetting all about her injury, Winning
Ticket
prepares to run off, but I hastily
stop her and
offer to buy the food
myself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I think... I ate too much. I'm about
to
explode... Uugh...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
No, I gotta hold on! I need my new, ultra
full
power to—
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Slump...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Phew! That hit the spot!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm so full! I feel revived! New, ultra
all-out
strength achieved!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer! I'm sure my injury will
heal in no
time now!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
In the end, Уиннинг Тикит is out for the
count,
and ends up having to stay in the
infirmary a
while longer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит is back to her usual
energetic self
and seems fired up to
make a comeback.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After I manage to calm her down,
Уиннинг Тикит
agrees to take enough
time to recover.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
